app.apiDown: Cannot reach the Niva server ({msg}). Check that it is running.
app.footer: Niva supports farmer judgement; it does not replace it. Check every plan with a local agronomist.
app.footerData: Data: NASA POWER, NASA SMAP, NASA MODIS, NASA NASADEM/SRTM, ISRIC SoilGrids, ZPIS and MakStat.
app.emptyText: Mark your field on the map below. The ESP32 in it then shows how healthy the soil is, and NASA data gives the crop rotation advice.

health.noReadings: No sensor readings for this field yet.
health.basis: Soil used to read the sensor: {soil}.
